verdict.rationale: Working Copy is an iOS Git client. Its SSH support covers Git transport and key management, not interactive terminal sessions, so keeping a terminal session alive across network changes and device sleep is outside its product category. Background Sync keeps Git syncing running while other apps are in use, which is a different feature and does not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can keep my terminal session alive across network changes and device sleep
